documents.summary: TLC page of sample syllabus statements, compiled from Western Michigan and Oklahoma State, that K-State instructors can adapt. It offers three levels (prohibited, permitted, required), all with citation and a tie to the K-State Honor Pledge. It is model language, not a binding university rule.
documents.stance_why: The page says 'Please add language to your syllabus regarding your policies toward AI tools' and offers statements headed 'AI Prohibited', 'AI Permitted' and 'AI Required' as 'examples'. It sets no stance itself and hands the choice to each instructor, so the stance is delegates and the three levels are listed in tiers.

units.why: An instruction to instructors: 'Please add language to your syllabus regarding your policies toward AI tools.' It asks instructors to put an AI statement in the syllabus, which is P09; 'Please add' is a recommendation, so modality is should.

notes: Only the three included university-layer documents were coded. The TLC page is model language, not a binding rule. The records policy is an unnumbered draft for employees and is not about coursework. The provost page lists the task force charge but no rules. Stance 'delegates' for the provost page is the nearest enum value since it sets no stance and defers to future policy. Repeated sentences in the TLC templates (the Honor Pledge sentence, the shared 'You may use' sentence) are coded once.
